production.visual_review: passed: Approved as a stylized game-scale interpretation of the supplied rounded shell ferry: sealed oval pressure body and closed bow/stern, readable cockpit and paired spherical shoulder pods, restrained ivory/terracotta/brass palette, connected landing struts with grounded feet, and a repaired full-height enclosed airlock vestibule with attached sill. The silhouette remains legible in the small catalog card; front/rear/side views show no open-barrel or split-fairing defect. Belly nozzle mounts are visually connected and above foot contact level. Dimensions 6.377 x 6.547 x 3.584 metres with grounded min Z 0; suitable for the intended 8 m pad. Static exterior approval only: runtime landing effects, collision behavior, boarding and database publication are not established by this art review.
